content:
tom_s: Heads-up: scheduling a maintenance window for APAC edge GPU pools to address intermittent NIC firmware flaps + kernel NVLink regression. Goal: rolling soft-reboots with zero data-loss, minimal tail latency impact. Window: 2026-04-02 18:00-21:00 SGT (UTC+8). We picked evening APAC to avoid peak EU/US traffic.

cheng_w: do we have a canary plan? want to validate NVLink kernel sig before broad roll. recommend 1 rack (8 nodes) canary, watch p99 and inter-node RPC errors for 30m. :eyes:

maria_k: +1 canary. also please pre-warm prefix/KV caches for chat-heavy tenants. I'll kick off cache-warm job 1h prior.

sre_lead_ana: tagging oncall: @sre-oncall please ack. we need tracers and alerting on: inference-p99, kv-cache-miss-rate, rpc-timeouts, and host-egress-errors. define abort criteria in runbook (>=5% rpc errors or p99 >2s sustained for 10m).

ops_bot: automated-check: capacity-headroom=12% across apac-pool at 17:00 SGT. no blocked tasks.

rajiv_p: what's the capacity hedge cost if we reserve extra nodes? rough calc pls.

tom_s: rough: for 3hr window reserve 50 GPUs (hot spare) ~ 50 * $0.50/hr * 3 = $75. we can instead prefer preemptible backfill for lower cost but higher eviction risk. I'll attach tradeoffs in runbook.

maria_k: on cache-warm: run this before canary: 
```
# simple kv prefill (pseudo)
for tenant in heavy_tenants.txt; do
  curl -s -X POST $REDWOOD_API/v1/cache/prefill -d '{"tenant": "$tenant", "prompts": ["<top-10-prompts>"]}'
done
```

cheng_w: kubectl snippet for the canary drain (preserve local scratch):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-canary-node-01
kubectl drain gpu-canary-node-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data=false --force=false --grace-period=120
```

sre_lead_ana: add rollback steps: 1) uncordon if instability persists, 2) route traffic to eu/us fallback pool, 3) escalate to runtime oncall. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-gpu-maint (use internal access).

ops_bot: preflight results attached: nvlink-driver-version=2.3.4 -> upgrade candidate 2.4.0, nic-fw 1.9.2 -> 1.9.5. no known CVEs.

tom_s: Action items: 
- canary: 18:00-18:45 SGT (8 nodes) - cheng + maria verify
- if green -> ramp cohorts of 16 nodes every 30m until done
- pre-warm cache 17:00 SGT - maria
- oncall watch + alert thresholds - ana
- cost hedge decision by 16:00 SGT - rajiv/tom

cheng_w: noted. will post canary metrics link during run.

maria_k: I'll schedule prefill and leave a short note in #customer-comms draft for affected tenants.

sre_lead_ana: ACK. I'll be on standby from 17:30 SGT and will open a dedicated incident channel if abort criteria hit. :heavy_check_mark:
